title: 🏆 Review: Units 4–6

scenes.t: {name} thinks about a great day. 'I had a big win at school!'
Omar felt sad. {name} helped him carry his books. Now Omar feels happy.
At home, {name} helps with the chores: 'I clean my room and wash the dishes.'
At school, the team plays together. They passed the ball and scored a goal. Teamwork wins!
'What is your goal?' asks the teacher. {name} says, 'I am working hard to be a scientist.'
{name} smiles. 'I did it! And I helped my friends do it too!'

items.q: Feeling happy about what you did:
A way to get something done:
To show happiness for something good:
Amir was ___ after playing all day.
Yara felt ___ when she fell in front of the class.
Omar and Ziad ___ a bridge across the stream.
Yesterday, Salma (plays / played) with her doll.
Now, she (is eating / ate) her lunch.
Last week, we (visit / visited) the zoo.
Look! The boys (run / are running) in the garden.
Fix it: what did basel do every day

what did Basel do every day.

activities.title: Writing: My Goal Story
activities.prompt: Write a story about achieving a goal.
points: What did you want to do?
What did you do to practice?
activities.note: Use the story frame and past tense verbs.
activities.punct: Capital letter at the start • period (.) at the end • comma after First, Then, Finally
model: First, I wanted to swim fast.
Then, I practiced every day at the club.
After that, I swam in a race with my friends.
Finally, I felt proud and happy because I won!
check: I used First, Then, After that, Finally
I used capital letters and periods

source: English – Primary 3 – Term 1 (Ministry of Education) pp. 114–116
